findings.problem: The subscribe/auto-push state word is concatenated straight onto the verb with no separator (« S’abonner {subscribe} ») and the clause is capitalised mid-sentence, so the accessible name reads « S’abonner Activé ; Push automatique Désactivé ». es, ru and zh label the two states with a separator here.
findings.fix: Label each state as the sibling locales do: « Abonnement : {subscribe} ; Push automatique : {autoPush}. » Apply the same to ui.hub.links.healthy_unsourced.
